facts.fact: A WARDIP Guinea-Bissau post of 8 August 2026 announces that the government approved the national interoperability regulation (regulamento nacional de interoperabilidade), giving no number or year and no gazette date; an appended note in the document says only a draft decree is independently confirmed. Dated by the post's published date.

note: Announcement only; no statement on whether public bodies are required to share, so no duty fact.
